rules.sentence: Acute exacerbation (AE)-ILD is defined as a new bilateral ground-glass opacity superimposed on a preexisting fibrotic pattern with no identifiable cause (excluding infection, cardiac failure, or volume overload) and is the most feared complication of IPF and other fibrotic ILDs.
